segmentos.en: # Language of the speech. Passed through to the model so a multilingual model
segmentos.es:
# ── TTS ENGINE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# "orpheus" = the Ollama/Orpheus + SNAC pipeline above (English). "piper" = a
# LOCAL, offline Piper neural voice. The SPANISH edition uses "piper" for a
# genuine Latin-American (Mexican) FEMALE voice, with no Ollama needed.
tts_engine: "piper"
# Download the Piper voice (.onnx/.onnx.json) from the official rhasspy/piper-voices
# on first use when missing. false = fully offline/pinned (you place the files).
piper_auto_download: true
# Install piper-tts into the carried Python on first use when missing.
piper_auto_install: true
# Where Piper voices live; "" = <LOCALAPPDATA>/Tlamatini/piper/voices.
piper_voices_dir: ""
# Optional explicit piper command; "" = run Piper from the carried Python.
piper_executable: ""

# Language of the speech. Passed through to the model so a multilingual model
segmentos.codigo: adaptacion de la voz al espanol latino (edicion Tlamatini-Spanish)

segmentos.es:
# Spanish edition default: "es" (the Piper Mexican voice speaks Spanish natively).
language: "es"
segmentos.codigo: adaptacion de la voz al espanol latino (edicion Tlamatini-Spanish)

segmentos.es:
# SPANISH edition: the Piper Mexican-Spanish FEMALE voice (used when tts_engine is
# "piper"). es_MX-claude-high is verified female; es_MX-ald is NOT permitted (its
# gender is undocumented). For the Orpheus engine use tara/leah/jess/mia/zoe.
voice: "es_MX-claude-high"
segmentos.codigo: adaptacion de la voz al espanol latino (edicion Tlamatini-Spanish)
